description: Implement a configuration system that allows users to specify additional dependencies for Monaco Editor's code execution environment. This should include updating the Monaco dependency resolution logic and providing clear documentation for users on how to configure these additional dependencies.
functional_requirements: Add support for a configuration option that allows users to specify additional dependencies for Monaco Editor's runtime environment
Update the Monaco dependency resolution logic to include user-specified dependencies alongside default ones
Create comprehensive documentation explaining how to configure additional dependencies with clear examples
